item.title: 4 arrested after toddler consumes meth left inside sippy cup: Florida deputies
item.description: Four people were arrested on Feb. 24 after a toddler consumed methamphetamine hidden in a sippy cup, according to the Nassau County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: State Department urges US citizens to leave more than a dozen Middle Eastern countries
item.description: Israel and the United States pounded Iran on Monday in a campaign that U.S. President Donald Trump said would likely take several weeks. Tehran and its allies hit back against Israel, Gulf states and targets critical to the world’s energy production.

item.title: Blood moon: Will total lunar eclipse be visible in Northeast Ohio?
item.description: A blood-red moon will soon grace the skies for a total lunar eclipse — and there won't be another until late 2028.

item.title: Video shows Hillary Clinton erupt at GOP over unauthorized Boebert photo during Epstein deposition
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton threatened to walk out of a deposition after Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-Colo.) shared a picture of her during testimony to the House Oversight Committee for their investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: US embassy in Riyadh struck by drones, Saudi Arabia says
item.description: The U.S. Embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, was struck by multiple drones on Monday following President Trump’s attacks on Iran.

item.title: Former daycare worker indicted after child injured: I-Team
item.description: A former local daycare worker has been indicted on charges of felonious assault and endangering children.

item.title: 'My home is gone': More than 130 residents displaced after Woodbury Commons fire
item.description: A massive fire has left more than 130 people without a home at the Woodbury Commons apartments on Stumph Road in Parma.

item.title: Looking ahead: Days and days of rain showers
item.description: A few showers and a brief wintry mix moving in for the morning drive. Temperatures will drop into the lower 30s this evening, and warm a few degrees overnight.

item.title: Trial begins this week for Amish mother accused of drowning 4-year-old son
item.description: The trial of an Amish mother, accused of aggravated murder for purposely drowning her four-year-old son at Atwood Lake last summer, is scheduled to get underway in a Tuscarawas County courtroom on Tuesday morning.

item.title: Cleveland homicide detectives investigating after 2 bodies found
item.description: The Cleveland Division of Police is investigating after two bodies were found off of East 162nd Street on Monday evening.
